functions.name: VmExtcall_MoviePlay
disassembly: call    VmGetTaskSchedulingState; Returns VM scheduling/input state bitmask. Bit 4 (0x10)=skip mode active. Bit 5 (0x20)=auto mode active. Bit 3 (0x08)=advance key pressed or mousewheel. Bit 2 (0x04)=confirm key on. Wait handlers check (result&0x30) to skip waits in skip/auto mode. Main loop checks (result&0x10/0x20) to control execution cadence.
